options.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 820 620" width="820" height="620">
  <defs>
    <style>
      .node-box { fill: #1a1a2e; stroke: #4a4a6a; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8; ry: 8; }
      .node-label { fill: #ffffff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: central; }
      .node-role { fill: #aaaacc; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: central; }
      .link { stroke-width: 3.5; fill: none; }
      .port-label { fill: #88ddff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: central; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="820" height="620" fill="#181B1F"/>

  <!-- ═══════════════════ LINKS ═══════════════════ -->

  <!-- xrd-1:Gi0/0/0/0 ↔ xrd-3:Gi0/0/0/2 -->
  <line id="link_xrd1_gi0_xrd3_gi2" class="link" x1="200" y1="300" x2="290" y2="190" stroke="#4BDD33"/>
  <!-- xrd-1:Gi0/0/0/1 ↔ xrd-5:Gi0/0/0/2 -->
  <line id="link_xrd1_gi1_xrd5_gi2" class="link" x1="200" y1="330" x2="290" y2="430" stroke="#4BDD33"/>

  <!-- xrd-2:Gi0/0/0/0 ↔ xrd-4:Gi0/0/0/2 -->
  <line id="link_xrd2_gi0_xrd4_gi2" class="link" x1="620" y1="300" x2="530" y2="190" stroke="#4BDD33"/>
  <!-- xrd-2:Gi0/0/0/1 ↔ xrd-6:Gi0/0/0/2 -->
  <line id="link_xrd2_gi1_xrd6_gi2" class="link" x1="620" y1="330" x2="530" y2="430" stroke="#4BDD33"/>

  <!-- xrd-3:Gi0/0/0/0 ↔ xrd-4:Gi0/0/0/0 -->
  <line id="link_xrd3_gi0_xrd4_gi0" class="link" x1="335" y1="170" x2="485" y2="170" stroke="#4BDD33"/>
  <!-- xrd-3:Gi0/0/0/1 ↔ xrd-5:Gi0/0/0/1 -->
  <line id="link_xrd3_gi1_xrd5_gi1" class="link" x1="290" y1="210" x2="290" y2="410" stroke="#4BDD33"/>
  <!-- xrd-3:Gi0/0/0/3 ↔ xrd-7:Gi0/0/0/0 -->
  <line id="link_xrd3_gi3_xrd7_gi0" class="link" x1="320" y1="150" x2="380" y2="90" stroke="#4BDD33"/>

  <!-- xrd-4:Gi0/0/0/1 ↔ xrd-6:Gi0/0/0/1 -->
  <line id="link_xrd4_gi1_xrd6_gi1" class="link" x1="530" y1="210" x2="530" y2="410" stroke="#4BDD33"/>
  <!-- xrd-4:Gi0/0/0/3 ↔ xrd-7:Gi0/0/0/1 -->
  <line id="link_xrd4_gi3_xrd7_gi1" class="link" x1="500" y1="150" x2="440" y2="90" stroke="#4BDD33"/>

  <!-- xrd-5:Gi0/0/0/0 ↔ xrd-6:Gi0/0/0/0 -->
  <line id="link_xrd5_gi0_xrd6_gi0" class="link" x1="335" y1="450" x2="485" y2="450" stroke="#4BDD33"/>
  <!-- xrd-5:Gi0/0/0/3 ↔ xrd-8:Gi0/0/0/0 -->
  <line id="link_xrd5_gi3_xrd8_gi0" class="link" x1="320" y1="470" x2="380" y2="540" stroke="#4BDD33"/>

  <!-- xrd-6:Gi0/0/0/3 ↔ xrd-8:Gi0/0/0/1 -->
  <line id="link_xrd6_gi3_xrd8_gi1" class="link" x1="500" y1="470" x2="440" y2="540" stroke="#4BDD33"/>

  <!-- ═══════════════════ PORT LABELS ═══════════════════ -->

  <!-- xrd-1 ports -->
  <text class="port-label" x="222" y="282">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="222" y="348">G1</text>

  <!-- xrd-2 ports -->
  <text class="port-label" x="598" y="282">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="598" y="348">G1</text>

  <!-- xrd-3 ports: G0→xrd4, G1→xrd5, G2→xrd1, G3→xrd7 -->
  <text class="port-label" x="350" y="158">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="272" y="225">G1</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="272" y="190">G2</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="302" y="135">G3</text>

  <!-- xrd-4 ports: G0→xrd3, G1→xrd6, G2→xrd2, G3→xrd7 -->
  <text class="port-label" x="470" y="158">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="548" y="225">G1</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="548" y="190">G2</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="518" y="135">G3</text>

  <!-- xrd-5 ports: G0→xrd6, G1→xrd3, G2→xrd1, G3→xrd8 -->
  <text class="port-label" x="350" y="462">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="272" y="395">G1</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="272" y="430">G2</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="302" y="485">G3</text>

  <!-- xrd-6 ports: G0→xrd5, G1→xrd4, G2→xrd2, G3→xrd8 -->
  <text class="port-label" x="470" y="462">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="548" y="395">G1</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="548" y="430">G2</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="518" y="485">G3</text>

  <!-- xrd-7 ports: G0→xrd3, G1→xrd4 -->
  <text class="port-label" x="383" y="102">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="437" y="102">G1</text>

  <!-- xrd-8 ports: G0→xrd5, G1→xrd6 -->
  <text class="port-label" x="383" y="528">G0</text>
  <text class="port-label" x="437" y="528">G1</text>

  <!-- ═══════════════════ NODES ═══════════════════ -->

  <!-- xrd-7 (PCE) - top center -->
  <rect id="node_xrd7" class="node-box" x="365" y="42" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="410" y="60">xrd-7</text>
  <text class="node-role" x="410" y="80">PCE</text>

  <!-- xrd-3 - upper left -->
  <rect id="node_xrd3" class="node-box" x="245" y="150" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="290" y="178">xrd-3</text>

  <!-- xrd-4 - upper right -->
  <rect id="node_xrd4" class="node-box" x="485" y="150" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="530" y="178">xrd-4</text>

  <!-- xrd-1 - middle left (src) -->
  <rect id="node_xrd1" class="node-box" x="145" y="285" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="190" y="305">xrd-1</text>
  <text class="node-role" x="190" y="325">src</text>

  <!-- xrd-2 - middle right (dst) -->
  <rect id="node_xrd2" class="node-box" x="585" y="285" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="630" y="305">xrd-2</text>
  <text class="node-role" x="630" y="325">dst</text>

  <!-- xrd-5 - lower left -->
  <rect id="node_xrd5" class="node-box" x="245" y="420" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="290" y="448">xrd-5</text>

  <!-- xrd-6 - lower right -->
  <rect id="node_xrd6" class="node-box" x="485" y="420" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="530" y="448">xrd-6</text>

  <!-- xrd-8 (vRR) - bottom center -->
  <rect id="node_xrd8" class="node-box" x="365" y="535" width="90" height="50"/>
  <text class="node-label" x="410" y="553">xrd-8</text>
  <text class="node-role" x="410" y="573">vRR</text>

  <!-- ═══════════════════ LEGEND ═══════════════════ -->
  <rect x="18" y="18" width="140" height="90" fill="#1a1a2e" stroke="#4a4a6a" rx="4"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="40" r="8" fill="#4BDD33"/>
  <text x="55" y="44" fill="#ccc" font-size="20" font-family="sans-serif">Link UP</text>
  <circle cx="38" cy="64" r="8" fill="#FF3154"/>
  <text x="55" y="68" fill="#ccc" font-size="20" font-family="sans-serif">Link DOWN</text>
  <circle cx="38" cy="88" r="8" fill="#808080"/>
  <text x="55" y="92" fill="#ccc" font-size="20" font-family="sans-serif">No data</text>
</svg>

panels.title: Network Topology

panels.description: Matrix view: rows=devices, columns=GigabitEthernet interfaces. Green=UP, Red=DOWN, Gray=not present on device.
panels.title: Interface State Matrix

panels.description: Matrix view: rows=source device, columns=neighbor device (derived from ISIS system ID). Green=adjacency UP, Red=DOWN. Requires system IDs follow pattern 0100.0100.010X.
panels.title: ISIS Neighborship Matrix

panels.description: UP=1, DOWN=0. Filter by device and interface using dropdowns above. Step lines make state changes immediately visible.
panels.title: Interface State

panels.description: UP=1, DOWN=0. Each line is a device→neighbour pair. Filter by device to focus on specific adjacencies.
panels.title: ISIS Adjacency State

panels.description: Number of up/down transitions in the selected time window. Useful for detecting unstable interfaces.
panels.title: Interface State Changes (flaps)

panels.description: Matrix view: rows=devices, columns=Loopback interfaces. Green=UP, Red=DOWN.
panels.title: Loopback State

panels.description: Up/down state of all Loopback interfaces. A loopback going down can cascade to ISIS, BGP, and other protocol failures.
panels.title: Loopback State

panels.description: Matrix view: rows=source device, columns=BGP peer IP address. Green=ESTABLISHED, Red=not established. Pattern reveals hub-and-spoke topology (most devices peer only to vRR xrd-8).
panels.title: BGP Sessions (iBGP Hub-and-Spoke)

panels.description: Transmit throughput per SR-TE tunnel. A flat line at 0 means the tunnel is dark (no traffic forwarded).
panels.title: SR-TE Tunnel TX Rate (bps)

title: XRd SR Topology Overview
